item.title: [IGNITE-16672] Attempt to re-create a cache with the same name may lead to error on getting corresponding page store
item.description:

The following scenario results in the mentioned exception:

  • user starts a new cache on the topology version X, and for some reason the start takes a significant amount of time
  • at the same time, the user tries to stop the cache with the same name, then starts it, stops it and starts it again.

The problem is that ClusterCachesInfo removed the required cache descriptor and PME on version X cannot be successfully finished.
